title: Distance to affine sign functions
statement: For a function $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, define its distance to the affine sign functions to be the minimum, over all sign vectors and all points of the binary cube, of the relative Hamming distance from $f$ to the corresponding affine sign function.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the length-$n$ binary cube to the real numbers
